structured_output.content: The release note says only that `FindZoneByFqdn` now caches the full DNS response and handles TTL expiration. The excerpt does not say which cert-manager code paths call it, so it does not tie the change to this environment. The environment shows a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD. It lists no Issuer, ClusterIssuer or Challenge resources, so any DNS01 solver configuration is not visible. Check whether your issuers use DNS01 challenges. If they do, review the changed zone-lookup caching behaviour. If they don't, this change likely has no effect.
